findings.message: Do not build a BaseError that names a declared failure. Call the tier that declares it: 'AccountModule.error(identifier, data, cause)', 'ApiWorker.error(...)', or 'Base.error(...)'. The status comes from the declaration, so writing it here is how one failure ends up answering two.
